reaction: The final picture ties the supply routes together clearly, though I would have liked to see their connection to working muscle more directly.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the meal to the muscular tract was most worthwhile: the resulting panels showed how the two muscle layers mix and move food, connecting tissue structure to its job.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding intestinal blood vessels felt somewhat repetitive after the absorbing lining, although it did clarify how sugar enters blood.

surprise.text: The distinction between digestion and absorption sharpened my understanding: breaking food molecules down and moving them across the gut wall are separate jobs.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the item descriptions and goals made the sequence understandable.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see how these supply systems support the working arm. The explanations are clear, though the choices so far have been fairly predictable.
